- Quo was also handling outbound callbacks and SMS; both features already exist in CallRail (dialer for callbacks with CallRail number display, A2P-registered SMS on trackers).
- A2P SMS registration needed and should start now (takes a few days).
- Proposed testing order: set up Telnyx connection and Zoiper, test Facebook tracker first with SIP endpoint, then roll out to other trackers and cancel Quo; defer Website pool and GBP migration until SIP is verified working.
